name: Blade Ward
description: Until the spell ends, any creature making an attack roll against you subtracts 1d4 from that roll.

name: Witch Bolt
description: Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit the target takes 2d12 Lightning damage. On each of your later turns while the spell lasts, you can take a Bonus Action to deal 1d12 Lightning damage to the target automatically, even if the first attack missed. The spell ends early if the target is more than 60 feet away or has Total Cover from you.
higherLevels: The initial damage increases by 1d12 for each spell slot level above 1.
